unseparated_sub_hypotheses._doc: Copilot 反对派审查提出、本 Step **未能**互相分开的子机制（三者都产生同一组可观测字段：target_in_prompt=True 且 picked=False）。Step 5 动手前应先用最便宜的那条鉴别实验收口，不要直接假定分页拉取就是答案。
unseparated_sub_hypotheses.B_tool_call_threshold: 候选已进入工作记忆但模型不敢调用工具。判据：system 明确要求「候选数<=5 时必须 read 验证」后，N=78 的 read_rate 从 <10% 升到 >80% 即证伪「纯目录检索失败」
unseparated_sub_hypotheses.C_position_bias: 决定因素可能不是 N=78 而是目标条目的排名位置。判据：固定 N=78，只洗牌目标排名（5/20/40/70），若 rank5 与 rank70 的 picked 率差 >40pct 则是位置偏置而非容量瓶颈
unseparated_sub_hypotheses.E_l0_summary_insufficient: 目标被降档到 L0 后失去关键区分特征、无法建立检索线索。判据：保持 N=78 与总 token 不变，仅把目标技能单独升到 L2，若成功率 0% → >80% 则是摘要信息缺失而非规模本身
unseparated_sub_hypotheses.F_premature_termination: Copilot 提出的第四类假设（本 Step 完全未测）：模型在目录阶段自认已有自洽答案、短路掉 read。判据：仅改 system 为「未 read 任何 SKILL.md 前禁止输出最终答案」，若 read_rate 从 <5% 升到 >80% 则「长目录选择」降为次要因素

anchor_pool_offline_validation._why: 旧 _sc_build_skill_pool() 的干扰名由 _SC_DISTRACTOR_TOPICS[(i*7+3)%68] 派生、目标位置由 md5(n) 派生 → 「名字字典序早于目标的同分（18 分）干扰项」在不在池里随 N 无规律开关（实测 n=44→池内 index 11、64→41、76→51、77→68、78→56）。因为目录按「分数降序 + 同分名字升序」排，目标的目录序号与 L2/L1 身份会随 N 跳变，于是 Step 4 的「N=77 通过 / N=78 失败」里混进了一个与技能数量无关的变量 —— 这正是前沿 77 与 1.75x 作废的原因。

design._k_rationale: k=2 的理由：2 条锚点已足够同时成立阶段 B 证明为决定性的两个条件——(1) 目标身边恒有与它逐字节同构的同分候选（同分竞争真实存在），(2) 目标恒非目录首条（目录序号恒为 3，因此在 l2_top_k=2 下恒被降到 L1，可复现阶段 B 的 baseline 形态）。再多锚点只会白占 skills 预算、把池体量与 token 曲线一起抬高，反而削弱跨 N 可比性；k=1 则目标序号变 2，在 l2_top_k=2 下会误进 L2，测不到那个被证实的失败形态。
design._anchor_selection: 两条锚点都取自 Step 2 第三轮引入的 4 条同分名里以 "calibration" 开头的部分——另两条 flux-capacitor-calibration-mirror/-backup 名字排序**晚于**目标（同前缀更长者更大），排在目标之后，做不了锚点。
design._filler_rationale: 填充项取自 _SC_DISTRACTOR_TOPICS 中名字侧关键词命中数恒为 0 的 18 条（离线复算得到），只拿与全体技能相同的描述侧 9 分，因此恒排在目标与锚点之后；改变 N 只增删它们，不会挤动目录前三位。名字仍是有真实感的主题词（reactor-/warp-/sensor- 系列），以维持单条目录条目体量接近真实场景。
design._target_index_note: 目标默认停在池内 index 0，不再由 md5(n) 派生。池内 index 与目录序号完全无关（目录只按分数降序 + 同分名字升序），target_index 参数只为兼容既有实验入口保留；阶段 B 已实测洗池内 index 根本移动不了目录序号。

mainline_a_tie_aware_l2_cpp_impl._doc: Step 5 stage C slice 2/3: C++ implementation of mainline (a) + remote falsification test.

implementation.semantics: When the l2_top_k boundary falls inside a group of same-score candidates, extend L2 to cover the whole tie group instead of cutting it. Budget overflow protection is inherited from the existing per-item degrade loop in AssignSkillDetailLevels() (L2->L1->L0, only dropped if even L0 does not fit).
implementation.rollback: tie_aware_l2=false reproduces byte-identical fixed-boundary legacy behavior (effective_l2_top_k == disclosure_cfg.l2_top_k, no extension).
implementation.binary_verified: GenieAPIService.exe (remote ARM64, commit d35ee3a) contains literal string 'tie_aware_l2' confirming the build includes this change.

falsification_test._pre_declared_threshold: Fixed N=78 and anchor pool composition, only raise l2_top_k / enable tie extension; if target already reaches L2 but picked_rate remains <0.8, mainline (a) loses its mainline status.
falsification_test.rollback_equivalence: Confirmed: tie_aware_l2=false exactly reproduces the stage-B baseline failure form (target stuck at L1); the flag genuinely changes behavior byte-for-byte on the disclosure-form axis.
falsification_test.verdict: MAINLINE (a) FALSIFIED per its own pre-declared threshold: even with tie_aware_l2 promoting the target to full L2 disclosure (5/5 trials), picked_rate stayed at 0.000 -- identical to the tie_aware_l2=false control. Getting the target into L2 is NOT sufficient to make the model read it on the anchor pool. This directly contradicts the stage-B (old, non-anchor pool) finding that raising l2_top_k 2->8 moved picked_rate 0.000->1.000 -- meaning that stage-B result was very likely itself an artifact of the old pool's composition confound (raising l2_top_k to 8 in the OLD pool changed which OTHER items entered L2 alongside the target, not just the target's own form), the same class of confound stage-C's anchor-pool refactor was built to eliminate for the frontier search.
falsification_test.implication: The anchor pool now holds the tie-break group (2 anchors + target, all L2) in a fixed relative order: anchor-audit-000, anchor-replica-001, target. The model still reads only the FIRST item in that group on all 10/10 trials (consistent with stage-B's byte-level finding that read_paths were 100% the first-sorted same-score candidate). Promoting the target's OWN disclosure level does not change its ORDER in the catalog. This suggests the real lever is catalog position/order among tied candidates, not disclosure depth -- i.e. line (c) 'stronger tie-break signal' is the better next candidate, not (a).
